title: Suez Canal blockage
description: Study vessel queuing and recovery. No linked trajectory dataset is bundled.

title: Hurricane Ian regional infrastructure disruption
description: Study weather, transport and connectivity. Historical operational records must be imported separately.

title: Canadian wildfire smoke over northeastern US
description: Compare fire observations, wind and air-quality histories.
limitations: No causal or forecast accuracy metrics are attached to this catalogue entry.

title: Tonga eruption and connectivity disruption
description: Compare event timing and connectivity loss with delayed source availability.
limitations: No operational time series or independently reviewed outage labels are bundled.

title: Pakistan floods
description: Study river forecasts, flood footprints and transport exposure.
limitations: A satellite flood footprint is not evidence that every intersecting asset failed.

title: FAA NOTAM outage and ground stop
description: Compare operational traffic before, during and after the documented ground stop.
limitations: Actual traffic and timing labels must be supplied before evaluation.
